title: Walk-in Interview — Visiting Faculty Required (Psychology), Fall 2026
text:
Walk-in Interview — Visiting Faculty Required (Psychology), Fall 2026

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan | Faculty of Social Sciences

Ref. No: I/DSS/AWKUM/2026/10469

Date: 27/08/2026

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan, a public sector university, requires the services of
Visiting Faculty
for semester
FALL – 2026
in the Department of Psychology. Interested candidates may appear through a walk-in interview as per the details below.

Position Details

S# | Subject | No. of Positions | Required Qualification
1 | Psychology | 02 | PhD/MS/MPhil in relevant field

Date:
August 31, 2026

Time:
10:00 AM – 02:00 PM

Venue:
Department of Psychology, Main Campus, AWKUM

No application will be entertained after the given date & time — candidates must reach the venue as scheduled.

Terms & Conditions

Interested candidates are required to bring original documents for interview (along with CV and attested photocopies of their all DMC's, Degrees, Experience Certificates, CNIC & 01 Passport Size Photograph).

The applicant shall have no Third Division in academic career.

CGPA less than 3.00 out of 4.00 shall be considered as Second Division.

The applicants are required to reach the venue on the given date & time. No application will be entertained after the given date & time.

In case of foreign degree, the applicant must produce HEC Equivalence Certificate.

In-service candidates shall apply through proper channel. They must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer/Institution.

No TA/DA shall be admissible.

Note:
Errors, omissions, if any, are liable to rectification by the University.

Dean, Faculty of Social Sciences

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Phone: 092-937-920570 | Email: dfss@awkum.edu.pk
